reuse.why: Keeps using link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse; there was no existing linking helper to reuse, so it builds one.

duplication.why: Collapses the five near-identical provider link functions into one linkBankAccount/saveLinkedAccount pair, so the new check is written once and the old duplication is removed.

placement.why: The guard and shared linking logic live in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, and the guard runs before any bank/account/payee write or sync call.

scope.why: The request only needed a guard, but the diff rewrites all five link handlers into a shared flow; worthwhile but a large unrequested refactor in the same change.

maintainability.why: One linking path is much easier to own, though saveLinkedAccount carries a syncSource === 'goCardless' branch for insert fields and a tables override for Akahu as provider special cases.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every provider link handler routes through linkBankAccount

disguised_duplication.where: none; the per-provider copies are actually removed and replaced with thin wrappers

one_place.where: assertNotAlreadyLinked, called once from linkBankAccount which all five provider link handlers (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking) use
